subject: Mathematics
title: Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations
summary: Complex number z = x + iy (i² = −1) ek point (x, y) hai Argand plane mein. Modulus |z| = origin se doori, argument arg z = positive x-axis se angle. Polar form z = r(cosθ + i sinθ) = re^{iθ} multiplication aur powers ko aasaan banata hai.
Conjugate z̄ = x − iy reflection hai real axis mein. z z̄ = |z|², |z₁z₂| = |z₁||z₂|, arg(z₁z₂) = arg z₁ + arg z₂ — JEE ke saare simplifications inhi par.
Cube roots of unity 1, ω, ω² (1 + ω + ω² = 0, ω³ = 1) ek alag favourite topic hai. Locus sawal |z − z₁| = r (circle) aur |z − z₁| = |z − z₂| (perpendicular bisector) se hal hote hain.
Quadratic ax² + bx + c = 0 ke roots (−b ± √D)/2a; D = b² − 4ac nature batata hai. Sum = −b/a, product = c/a — inse bina roots nikaale symmetric expressions aur naye equations ban jaate hain.

formulas.name: Powers of i
formulas.formula: i² = −1, i³ = −i, i⁴ = 1;  iⁿ = i^{n mod 4};  i + i² + i³ + i⁴ = 0
formulas.mistake: √a √b = √(ab) sirf jab dono non-negative ho; √(−4)√(−9) = −6, +6 nahi.

formulas.name: Algebra of complex numbers
formulas.formula: (a + ib) ± (c + id) = (a ± c) + i(b ± d);  (a + ib)(c + id) = (ac − bd) + i(ad + bc);  division: numerator aur denominator ko denominator ke conjugate se multiply karo

formulas.name: Conjugate properties
formulas.formula: z + z̄ = 2 Re z;  z − z̄ = 2i Im z;  z z̄ = |z|²;  conj(z₁ ± z₂) = z̄₁ ± z̄₂;  conj(z₁z₂) = z̄₁z̄₂;  z real ⇔ z = z̄;  purely imaginary ⇔ z = −z̄

formulas.name: Triangle inequality
formulas.note: Equality tab jab z₁, z₂ same direction (ya ulti) mein hon.

formulas.name: Argument
formulas.formula: tanα = |y/x|;  principal arg θ ∈ (−π, π]:  Q1 α,  Q2 π − α,  Q3 −(π − α),  Q4 −α;  arg(z₁z₂) = arg z₁ + arg z₂;  arg(z₁/z₂) = arg z₁ − arg z₂
formulas.mistake: Quadrant dekh kar θ lo — sirf tan⁻¹(y/x) galat ho sakta hai.

formulas.name: Polar and Euler form
formulas.formula: z = r(cosθ + i sinθ) = re^{iθ};  z₁z₂ = r₁r₂ e^{i(θ₁ + θ₂)}

formulas.name: De Moivre's theorem
formulas.formula: (cosθ + i sinθ)ⁿ = cos nθ + i sin nθ

formulas.name: Square root of a + ib
formulas.note: b negative ho to imaginary part ka sign negative.

formulas.name: Locus in Argand plane
formulas.formula: |z − z₀| = r: circle;  |z − z₁| = |z − z₂|: perpendicular bisector;  |z − z₁| + |z − z₂| = 2a (> |z₁ − z₂|): ellipse;  arg((z − z₁)/(z − z₂)) = constant: circle ka arc

formulas.name: Quadratic formula and discriminant
formulas.formula: x = (−b ± √D)/2a,  D = b² − 4ac;  D > 0 real distinct,  D = 0 real equal,  D < 0 complex conjugate pair;  D perfect square (rational coefficients) ⇒ rational roots
formulas.note: Complex roots hamesha conjugate pair mein (real coefficients ke saath).

formulas.name: Sum and product of roots
formulas.formula: α + β = −b/a;  αβ = c/a;  α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ;  |α − β| = √D/|a|

formulas.name: Common root
formulas.formula: a₁x² + b₁x + c₁ = 0 aur a₂x² + b₂x + c₂ = 0 ka ek common root: (c₁a₂ − c₂a₁)² = (a₁b₂ − a₂b₁)(b₁c₂ − b₂c₁);  dono roots common: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂

formulas.name: Extreme value of a quadratic
formulas.formula: ax² + bx + c ka vertex x = −b/2a par;  value = −D/4a;  a > 0 ⇒ minimum, a < 0 ⇒ maximum

examples.title: Modulus aur argument
examples.problem: z = 1 + i√3 ka modulus aur principal argument?
examples.solution: |z| = √(1 + 3) = 2. Q1 mein, tanα = √3 ⇒ arg z = π/3. Polar: 2(cos π/3 + i sin π/3).

examples.title: Division
examples.solution: Conjugate (1 + i) se multiply: (1 + i)²/(1 + 1) = 2i/2 = i.

examples.title: Sum of squares of roots
examples.problem: x² − 5x + 6 = 0 ke roots ka α² + β²?

examples.title: Equal roots
examples.problem: x² + kx + 9 = 0 ke roots barabar hon to k?

examples.title: Locus
examples.solution: z ki (1, 0) aur (−1, 0) se barabar doori ⇒ perpendicular bisector x = 0, yaani imaginary axis.

topics.title: Argand plane
topics.explain: x-axis real axis, y-axis imaginary axis. z = x + iy ka point (x, y). |z₁ − z₂| = do points ki doori. iz = z ko 90° anticlockwise ghumana.

topics.title: Rotation
topics.explain: z₂ − z₀ = (z₁ − z₀)(r₂/r₁)e^{iθ}: point z₁ ko z₀ ke around θ se ghumaaya. Equilateral triangle: z₁² + z₂² + z₃² = z₁z₂ + z₂z₃ + z₃z₁.

topics.title: ω ke uses
topics.explain: x³ = 1 ke roots. x² + x + 1 = 0 ke roots ω, ω². 1, ω, ω² Argand plane mein equilateral triangle ke vertices (unit circle par). a + bω + cω² type expressions ka modulus.

topics.title: Nature of roots aur graph
topics.explain: y = ax² + bx + c parabola: a > 0 upar khula. D > 0 ⇒ x-axis ko do jagah kaatta; D = 0 ⇒ chhoota; D < 0 ⇒ nahi kaatta (a > 0 par hamesha positive).

topics.title: Sign scheme aur location of roots
topics.explain: Dono roots k se bade: D ≥ 0, af(k) > 0, −b/2a > k. Ek root k se chhota ek bada: af(k) < 0. Inequalities ax² + bx + c > 0 roots ke bahar (a > 0).

topics.title: Symmetric functions
topics.explain: α³ + β³ = (α + β)³ − 3αβ(α + β). 1/α + 1/β = (α + β)/αβ. Roots ko badal kar (jaise 1/α, α + 1) nayi equation: x ko us transformation ke ulte se badlo.

ratta: z z̄ = |z|²;  |z₁z₂| = |z₁||z₂|;  arg(z₁z₂) = arg z₁ + arg z₂.
D = b² − 4ac;  α + β = −b/a;  αβ = c/a.
